---
title: "Glue pairs"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-glue-pairs
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
source("R/edges.R")
library(DT)
diffs <- stat_table("length-diff")
# The full per-edge table is only in a local build (`make preview`), never on the public site.
edges <- if (file.exists("generated/edges.csv")) read_edges("generated/edges.csv")
```

Every edge number is printed twice in the template: once on the edge and once on the tab that is glued to it. The converter measures the edge each number sits on and pairs the two. A pair is *matching* when it found exactly one edge and one tab of the same length (status `ok`); anything else needs a look.

```{r}
#| label: glue-pairs-histogram
#| fig-cap: "Length difference between the two edges of each numbered pair, in 1 mm bins."
if (is.null(diffs)) {
  cat("No summary statistics are committed yet (`make report-data`).\n")
} else {
  diffs |>
    ggplot(aes(diff_mm + 0.5, n, fill = verdict)) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = VERDICT_COLOURS) +
    labs(x = "length difference between the two edges (mm)", y = "edge numbers", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: glue-pairs-local
#| output: asis
if (!is.null(edges)) cat("## Every pair\n\nLocal build only. `A` is the first piece of the pair, `B` its partner, lengths in mm.\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: glue-pairs-table
#| column: page-right
if (!is.null(edges)) {
  glue_pairs(edges) |>
    mutate(across(c(verdict, status, side_a, side_b, ocr_a), factor)) |>
    datatable(
      rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", class = "compact stripe",
      colnames = c("Number", "Verdict", "Status", "Piece A", "Side A", "Length A",
                   "Piece B", "Side B", "Length B", "Diff", "A read"),
      options = list(pageLength = 25)
    ) |>
    formatStyle("verdict", color = styleEqual(c("matching", "needs work"), c("#1a9e8f", "#d61f69")),
                fontWeight = "bold")
}
```
